correctness.rationale: Homogeneity identifies labeled nonalgebraic one-types with strict L/U ideal-filter pairs. A lower ideal with union support S has a_|S| possibilities by binomial inversion; among the M_{n-|S|} upsets above S precisely one is forbidden for principal ideal ↓S. Therefore sum binom(n,s)a_s M_{n-s}-2^n holds including B_0, and exponential convolution gives formal e^{-z}M(z)^2-e^{2z}. The boundary indices s=0,1,n-1,n give 4M_n+2nM_{n-1}; the remaining s range is exponentially lower under established log2 M_n~binom(n,floor n/2) with the middle coefficient maximum controlled at s=2/n-2. The EGF is explicitly formal, not analytic. Brute ideal/upset count independently checked n≤4 and all stated n≤8 values against the established M_n table; bounded enumeration is not a proof of the asymptotic.
